svg.title: The 28 tools in revit-mcp
svg.desc: Nineteen read tools for the model and its structure, six picture tools, one export tool and two gated write tools: Model and structure: revit_status, model_overview, list_levels, list_categories, query_elements, element_details, list_views, list_sheets, list_families, model_warnings, list_schedules, read_schedule, current_selection, list_rooms, project_structure, list_materials, wall_layers, geometry_quantities, check_clashes; Pictures: export_view_image, scene_info, render_scene, render_gallery, render_photoreal, render_turntable; Export: export_model; Writes, gated and previewed: create_schedule, set_parameter

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 28 tools. Two can change the model.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Everything else reads, renders or exports. Writes need two switches and are previewed first.
